[At] How do you remove a queued at job?
[At command ]Schedule a command to run two minutes later.
What daemon runs commands repeatedly at scheduled intervals?
[Cron] What are the five cron timing fields?
column2: Minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.

column1: [Cron] What does `*` mean in a cron field?
column2: Every possible value for that field.

column1: [Cron] What number represents Sunday in the day-of-week field?
[Cron] What does `*/15` mean in a cron field?
column2: Every 15 units of that field, e.g. every 15 minutes when used in the minute field.

column1: [Cron] How do you edit a user's personal crontab?
[Cron] How can you discard cron command output?
[System Cron] What is the format of a system-wide cron entry?
column2: Minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, username, command.

column1: [System Cron] The system-wide crontab file; its entries include a username field.
[System Cron] Should you normally edit `/etc/crontab` directly for custom jobs?
[Cron Directories] Do scripts in `/etc/cron.daily/` contain five cron timing fields?
column2: No. They are executable scripts; the directory determines the schedule.

column1: [Cron Directories] When do scripts in `/etc/cron.monthly/` run?
column2: They run on the first day of every month or according to the system's configured schedule.

column1: [Cron] How can comma-separated values be used in cron?
column2: They specify multiple values, e.g. `9,39` in the minute field runs at minutes 9 and 39.
